peach-dim.note: Hard-coded in site.css (not yet a custom property); reused for secondary text on the red field and in the lightbox.

display.purpose: The hero name only, two lines.

headline.purpose: Section headings; newsletter heading steps down to clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem).

caption.purpose: Sub-captions, field labels, errors, lightbox captions, in the field's secondary colour.

hairline.name: line
hairline.purpose: The single stroke weight for rules, beams, ropes, underlines, pill borders and the hoop. Focus outline (2px) is the one exception.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for entrances and fill/underline transitions. A few colour/border transitions (links, inputs, social and lightbox buttons) still run on the browser default ease (drift).

motion.name: develop
motion.value: opacity 0 -> 1 over 1.2s, filter blur(14px) -> 0 over 1.4s, translate 0 1.5rem -> 0 over 1.2s
motion.purpose: Photographs entering the viewport, once (IntersectionObserver adds/removes .pending).

motion.name: develop-lightbox
motion.purpose: Lightbox image on open and on each navigation.

motion.name: ring-close
motion.purpose: Hero hoop drawn closed on load, once.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Pill and round-button fill and colour changes.

motion.name: plate-hover
motion.value: scale 1 -> 1.025 over 0.9s inside a clipped frame

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: .motion class only added when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce (or ?static)
motion.purpose: All entrances are skipped under reduced motion; smooth scroll is disabled.

components.css: .ds-stage { position: relative; background: #f3bba3; padding: 0 0 40px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-beam { display: block; height: 1.5px; background: #3a0e0c; margin: 0 24px 56px; } .ds-hung { position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: 140px; margin: 0 auto; } .ds-ring { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 0; z-index: -1; width: 140%; aspect-ratio: 1; translate: -50% -8%; overflow: visible; } .ds-ring circle { fill: none; stroke: #a11f1b; stroke-width: 1.5px; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-rope { position: absolute; left: 50%; bottom: calc(100% + 7.4%); z-index: -1; width: 1.5px; height: 60px; translate: -50% 0; background: #a11f1b; } .ds-photo { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f0a28a, #e48d78); }

narrative.overview:
The page is a studio sweep with rigging in it. A warm peach ground stands in for the paper backdrop of the owner's own photographs, and a single red hoop (the lyra), drawn as one hairline stroke, hangs from the header rule by one rope. Everything else on the page obeys the same physics: photographs hang from hairline beams, inputs sit on hairline underlines, buttons are pills (a hoop seen flat). Ornament is that line and nothing else; the photographs carry all the colour and texture.

Density is low and the rhythm is generous: wide gutters, tall section spacing, light large type for names and headings, regular type for reading. Depth comes from colour fields, not from shadow: the page drops from the peach ground into a deep red field for About and the footer, and into opaque oxblood for the lightbox. Motion is a single grammar: one exponential ease-out, opacity plus blur, played once, as if a print were developing.

The build rejects the category default of a dark full-bleed photo with a serif name centred on top, and it has no shadows, cards or boxed containers.
keyCharacteristics: One hairline weight (1.5px) for every rule, beam, rope, underline, pill border and the hoop.
One face, Jost: light (300) and large for display, regular (400) for reading, medium (500) for labels.
Peach ground, deep red fields, oxblood ink; red reserved for the hoop, the rope and interaction.
Pills and circles are the only rounded forms; photographs are square-cornered.
Photographs develop into view once (opacity, blur, small rise) on one expo ease-out.

rules.name: The Two Fields Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are either peach (ground) or Cabaret Red (About, footer); oxblood appears only behind the lightbox. No third surface colour, no tinted cards.

rules.name: The Red Belongs to the Hoop Rule
rules.body: On peach, Hoop Red is reserved for the hoop, its rope and interaction (link underlines, hover, focus, caret, selection). Structural hairlines (beams, hang lines, pill borders, underlines) and all text stay Oxblood Ink or Faded Ink. The tagline separators are the one place red sits inside a line of text.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Jost is the only family. Hierarchy comes from size and weight (300 / 400 / 500), never from a second face, italics or uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Light Display Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 300 with tight negative tracking and balanced wrapping; never bold.

rules.name: The Hang Rule
rules.body: Every photograph grid starts at a hairline beam (a 1.5px top rule) and each plate hangs from it on a 1.5px vertical line centred on the plate, 2.5rem long in the disciplines and running the full column height in the portfolio, so a column reads as one line.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Hover changes fill, colour, underline offset or a 1.025 image scale inside a clipped frame; it never adds shadow or vertical lift.

rules.name: The One Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every rule, frame, underline, rope and ring is 1.5px. The single exception is the 2px focus outline, kept heavier for accessibility.

dos: **Do** draw every line at the 1.5px hairline (`--line`), in ink on peach and in Highlight Peach on red.
**Do** hang new photograph groups from a hairline beam, each image on its own centred line.
**Do** use the pill (999px, 1.5px border) for every button and a 3rem circle for icon-only controls.
**Do** bring photographs in once with the develop entrance: opacity 0, 14px blur and a 1.5rem rise, resolving over 1.2-1.4s on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and skip it under reduced motion.
**Do** keep text in Oxblood Ink or Faded Ink on peach, and Highlight Peach or Dimmed Peach on red.
**Do** set headings in Jost 300 with -0.025em tracking.
donts: **Don't** add box shadows, cards, boxed panels or rounded photo corners.
**Don't** introduce a second typeface, a serif display name, or a dark full-bleed photo with the name centred on top.
**Don't** use oxblood as a section surface; it belongs behind the lightbox only.
**Don't** add a second ornament beside the hoop; the photographs carry colour and texture.
**Don't** use more than one easing curve or loop an entrance; motion plays once.
